messages:
ella: Ok team  tiny idea: 'Court Siders Cold Brew Bracket' for the tournament. Loser buys the office cold brew and a pastry. Cheap, classy, competitive. :basketball: :coffee:

devon: Love it. How are we scoring? Bracket picks or weekly matchups?

ella: Bracket, single elimination. 2 points per correct round 1 upset (lower seed beats higher), 4 points for picking champion, 1 bonus for correct final score margin (closest). $3 entry?

samir: $3 Venmo works. Can we add a "most creative bracket name" prize? I will absolutely win that. :sunglasses:

maya: Yes please. Also please don't make the trophy a plastic mug again. It leaked last year.

luis: I'll design a small enamel pin as a trophy this time. Low fuss.

ella: Enamel pin is amazing. Winner gets pin + bragging board photo. Runner-up buys cold brew.

devon: Schedule a live pick party? 7pm Thursday in breakroom with pastries and a projector? Or people can submit online.

ella: Hybrid works. Picks lock at tip-off Friday. Live party at 7pm Thursday. Events-bot can create the calendar. @events-bot schedule picks party Thurs 19:00 PT and lock Friday 19:00 PT.

events-bot: Event created: "Court Siders Cold Brew Bracket  Picks Party" 2026-03-12 19:00 PT. Picks lock: 2026-03-13 19:00 PT. Reminders 2h and 30m before.

maya: Rules suggestion: tie-breaker predict total combined points in final. If still tied, oldest person in bracket buys the pastry. (Not kidding)

samir: Ouch. Can we flip seating order instead?

luis: Also: upsets defined by seeding only, not cultural upsets (aka my bracket heartbreak).

ella: Fine, tie-breaker is combined final score; second tie-breaker is Rock-Paper-Scissors (in-person). Oldest pastry buyer is the nuclear option.

devon: Spreadsheet link please so I can paste terrible bracket names.

ella: Posted: https://tiny.reddo/courtsiders-bracket (DM invites). Columns: name, seed picks, bracket name, venmo_txn, notes.

maya: Bracket name submitted: "Cold Brew & Clutch". You're welcome.

samir: I will submit "Samir's Sweet Revenge". Also Venmo sent.

luis: Pin concept sketch incoming tonight. Small gold bounce hoop, coffee bean accent. Thoughts?

ella: Love. Make it wearable on lanyards.

devon: If I win I'm framing the pin and putting it on my wall. Also I will post victory pic ok? :camera_with_flash:

ellA: (typo) Edited my picks, spreadsheet updated. If anyone else edits after lock I will ban them from pastry for a week. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

events-bot: Reminder posted to channel 2026-03-13 17:00 PT: "Picks lock in 2 hours for Court Siders Bracket".

maya: See y'all at the picks party or in the spreadsheet. May the best underdog win.
